column1: The usual advertisement posters, rate schedules, and rules and regulations. Nothing special.
column2: 一般的廣告海報、費率表、規章制度。沒什麼特別。

column1: Nothing unusual about it. You ride up one side, and down the other.
column2: 沒什麼異常。你從一側搭上去，再從另一側下來。

column1: That's an escalator.
column2: 那是手扶梯。

column1: No problem with the lights.
column2: 燈光沒有問題。

column1: You think to yourself, "Nice floor."
column2: 你心想：「地板不錯。」

column1: Through the window and across the street, the parking lot seems to go on forever.
column2: 透過窗戶望向街對面的停車場，似乎無邊無際。

column1: You see an airliner parked in the passenger loading zone.
column2: 你看見一架客機停在旅客上下車區。

column1: Looking around you see see a car rental agency near the escalator.
column2: 你環顧四周，看見手扶梯旁有一家租車公司。

column1: He sure is scruffy-looking for a businessman.
column2: 以商人來說，他看起來真邋遢。

column1: The customer sure is a well-tailored fellow....Why, isn't that Donald Trump?!?
column2: 那名客人穿著講究……咦，他不是唐納德．川普嗎？！

column1: You look at nothing in particular.
column2: 你沒有特別看什麼。

column1: The car rental agent kind of looks like your ex-girlfriend's husband.
column2: 租車員有點像你前女友的丈夫。

column1: There are two agents behind the counter at the Siva Car Rental agency.
column2: Siva 租車公司櫃檯後有兩名職員。

column1: The girl who works at at the car rental counter is pleasingly plump.
column2: 租車櫃檯工作的女孩身材豐滿可愛。

column1: There are lots of cars outside.
column2: 外面有很多車。

column1: No one can hear you from where you're standing.
column2: 你站的位置沒有人聽得見。

column1: Is there anything in particular you wanted to talk about? the rental agent says.
column2: 租車員說：「你特別想談什麼嗎？」

column1: The suave-looking customer says, "Have you seen what I've done with Manhattan Island? It's pure quality...pure quality!"
column2: 那名看似老練的客人說：「你看過我在曼哈頓島做的事嗎？那是純粹的品質……純粹的品質！」

column1: These guys don't seem to be listening.
column2: 這些人似乎沒有在聽。

column1: Mmpf..spst..lousy connecting flights..spfts..call my boss.. grmbl..spft the scruffy-looking man mutters under his breath.
column2: 「嗯……噗……糟糕的轉機……噗……打給我老闆……咕噥……噗。」邋遢男人低聲咕噥。

column1: You show your badge to the car rental agent, and she says... "Yes sir, Officer Bonds! What can I do for you?"
column2: 你向租車女職員出示警徽，她說……「是的，邦茲警官！我能為你做什麼？」

column1: You show your badge to the car rental agent, and he says... "Yes sir, Officer Bonds! What can I do for you?"
column2: 你向租車男職員出示警徽，他說……「是的，邦茲警官！我能為你做什麼？」

column1: So you're a cop....ask me if I care! I'm too tired to care!
column2: 「所以你是警察……問我在不在乎！我累到沒心情在乎！」

column1: No one can see your shield from where you're standing.
column2: 你站的位置沒有人看得見你的警徽。

column1: You're losing it, friend. Better back off.
column2: 你失控了，朋友。最好退後。
